text:
[Council File 26-0008-S16; CD 15]
Resolution (McOsker – Blumenfield) relative to prohibiting the parking of vehicles that are in excess of 22 feet in length or over 84 inches in height, during all hours of the day and night, along both sides of certain street segments in Council DIstrict 15.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
